# Native import original-source vectors

These 49 vectors are observations from the actual Bun 1.4.0 source handlers at `5ac0ac0dbf574272afcfd682374ca58899ac02c5`, not passing Rust gateway tests or native-import acceptance. `vectors.json` contains compact synthetic input descriptors; `expected.json` is the captured source outcome, including raw input hashes. Large 32-MiB/5-MiB boundaries are generated temporarily, never committed as blobs. `provenance.json` binds source/runtime/fixture hashes, exact command, denied network/credential environment, references and unproved surfaces.

`oracle.mjs` invokes the existing `readJsonBodyWithLimit`, `parseCodexAuthFromAuthJson`, actual AUTH/PROFILE route handlers and the repository's existing synthetic KV harness. The only fetch replacement is the exact pre-existing successful catalog fixture identified in provenance; no external/provider fetch runs. The frozen clock/UUID sequence is fixture-only. Both raw OS errno1 and Bun-masked `ECONNREFUSED` are retained; the synthetic `.env` read is denied with `EPERM`.

Observed order is KV availability first; AUTH raw guard then shape; PROFILE profile selector, then body/5-MiB guard, then `write`/`dry_run` conflict. Only the profile selector is pre-body. Partial PROFILE422 retains the earlier valid in-memory fixture row. AUTH invalid/empty/oversize stays400, PROFILE oversize stays413. An empty/invalid snake-case client version wins over camel-case before the source defaults; a nonstring snake value permits camel fallback. Captured expected values are not manually authored.

The exact source-bound launcher/capture receipts are under `/tmp/ai-rust-wasm-20261018/native-import-conformance-1823/`. Execute only through the recorded credential-empty, no-dotenv/no-install, OS-network-denied immutable snapshot and existing `mac-tooling.lock`/evidence-helper route. A bare unconfined Bun command is not the acceptance command. Future native tests may consume these inputs/results only after root lands the actual shared API and explicitly authorizes the dependent tests; this fixture subtree changes no API, product module, route or registration.

Unproved: real401/429/refresh behavior, native MAC/prepared-action/currentness/cancellation, DB durability/custody/inverse, actual local-client operation and gateway acceptance. The exact32-MiB AUTH descriptor uses valid JSON `{}` plus padding: its parser accepts the boundary, while the AUTH shape still produces400. This is not a successful giant credential-document claim.
